tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is 20 while all pilot horizons are below 0.5. A slow-horizon probe can distinguish reversal from the monotone alternative and calibrate the slow exponential.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-exponential model to five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short pilot does not identify the slow reversal reliably at the target horizon.
The principal uncertainty is the long-horizon response, which this probe does not directly resolve.
Fine short-trajectory sampling is less targeted than long-horizon measurements.
It does not resolve the relevant temporal mechanism.
